messages.subject: Lisbon satellite office - big opportunity 🚀
messages.body:
Hola Marta,

Following up on my hunch from the pipeline review: Portuguese courier market is growing fast, we already get inbound from Lisbon area (two leads last quarter!), and labour costs there are meaningfully lower than Rotterdam. A small satellite office - 3-4 people, sales plus maybe one support - would let us cover Portugal and Spain properly without relocating anyone.

I've seen some affordable spaces near the Alcântara area, roughly half our per-m² cost here. Helen, would love your take on the numbers if this gains traction ✅

Can we put it on the agenda for the next leadership meeting?

Saludos,
Tomás

messages.subject: RE: Lisbon satellite office - big opportunity 🚀
messages.body:
hey!

would love this - my Portuguese is rusty but usable, and I'd volunteer for a scouting trip 😉 the two Iberian leads together are maybe €2k/mrr so early days, but Tomás is right that nobody is covering that region properly.

cheers,
Samir

messages.body:
interesting. not now. we're mid-launch and mid-lease and helen's plate is full. if iberian pipeline ever justifies it, we look again.

M

messages.body:
Understood, park it ✅ I'll keep an eye on the Iberian pipeline and bring it back with real numbers if it grows. Samir, keep feeding me any PT/ES inbound!

Saludos,
Tomás
